🎁 FREE GAME ALERT: Bread & Fred, Yours to Keep!

Epic Games Store just made Bread & Fred free to claim, and it's yours to keep forever if you grab it before December 3, 2026. It's a co-op platformer starring two penguins — Bread and Fred — climbing a treacherous, candy-colored mountain together, built for two players whether you're on the couch or playing online.

Just add it to your library before the offer ends on December 3 and there's nothing more to pay, no subscription required.

🕗 Posted: 20:03 GMT+3, Nov 26, 2026

📰 Sources: Epic Games Store

👥 x.com/EpicGames

💬 Tag a friend to co-op this one with, and claim it before Dec 3!
